newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Commercial down 1.9 pct on ex-rights.
newsitem.headline: Commercial down 1.9 pct on ex-rights.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Bank Ltd fell two rupees or 1.9 percent to 105 rupees after going ex-rights on Monday, brokers said.
"Due to the dilution with the rights issue, the price naturally fell in the first trade on the day the share went ex-rights," said Ajit Wanagasekera of Commercial Stock Brokers.
Commercial Bank offered a one-for-four rights issue in June, at 100 rupees a voting share and 85 rupees a non-voting share.
This increased issued share capital of Commercial Bank to 26.6 million shares from 21.6 million.
The company is one of four private commercial banks listed in Colombo.
